name: Haryana

topAttractions.name: Tughlaqabad Fort
topAttractions.description: A 14th-century fort built by the Tughlaq dynasty, showcasing the architectural style of the era.

topAttractions.name: Kurukshetra
topAttractions.description: A sacred site in Hinduism, known for the epic battle of the Mahabharata, and home to the Jyotisar Lake.

topAttractions.name: Taj-e-Gaj
topAttractions.description: A 10th-century temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, featuring intricate carvings and sculptures.

topAttractions.name: Panipat Museum
topAttractions.description: A museum showcasing the history of the region, with a focus on the three battles of Panipat.

topAttractions.name: Sultanpur Bird Sanctuary
topAttractions.description: A protected area for migratory birds, with over 100 species recorded.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March, when the weather is mild and pleasant.
culturalFact: Haryana is home to the traditional craft of Zardozi embroidery, a delicate and intricate form of embroidery that originated in the Mughal era.

hiddenGem.name: The Royal Residency
hiddenGem.description: A 19th-century palace turned hotel, offering a glimpse into the region's royal past.

relatedFestival: The Kurukshetra Mahotsav, a festival celebrating the epic battle of the Mahabharata, held annually in Kurukshetra.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps from the Taj Mahal in Agra or the Red Fort in Delhi, you'll love exploring the rich history and architecture of Haryana!
